glossary.definition: An external issuer whose signed JWTs a product accepts: the config names the issuer string, the key set (JWKS URL or pasted), the accepted audiences and which time claims are required.

Identity Assertion JWT Authorization Grant (RFC 7523 profile): a short-lived JWT an authorization server issues so an agent can get an access token from another authorization server without sharing a client secret.
RFC 8693: trading a subject token (and optionally an actor token) for a new token, with the trust decision on the incoming token made by the exchange endpoint.
JSON Web Key Set: the public keys a product fetches (or is given) to verify a JWT's signature.
PingOne Privilege's workload-identity federation: a non-human identity authenticates with its own JWT signed by an issuer the tenant trusts, instead of a static key.
